//: Which STUDIO this builds is set by STUDIO_SLUG. app.config.ts reads it and resolves everything else from whitelabel/studios/<slug>/studio.json. Build a specific studio: STUDIO_SLUG=everyday-ballet eas build --profile development --platform ios

development.//: The everyday dev loop. Includes the dev client, so Metro can attach — this is what replaces Expo Go now that the app has native modules.

preview.//: A release-configuration build that still installs outside the store — TestFlight rehearsals and studio-staff testing. Points at production because that is what a tester should see.

production.//: Store submissions. app.config.ts calls validateStudioForRelease under this profile, so a studio missing its bundle id, Apple team, merchant id, or privacy policy URL fails here rather than at App Store Connect.

Apple credentials are configured PER PROJECT via `eas credentials`, not here and not at the account level. That is what lets one Expo organization submit to several different Apple Developer teams — Dibs's own team for the two rescue apps, and each studio's own team for any future studio-owned listing (Apple Guideline 4.2.6).
